evals.prompt: Átírtam a szöveg függőleges igazítását a renderben, most elhasalnak a golden tesztek. Frissítsd a goldeneket.
evals.expected_output: Runs cargo test -p labely-render filtered, lists failing goldens with pixel counts, views committed and actual PNGs, confirms only text goldens changed, runs cargo xtask bless, checks git diff --stat on crates/render/tests/golden, reruns tests, and proposes a commit message naming the changed goldens and why.

evals.prompt: codes_300: 412 pixels differ after I bumped the barcode crate. Can you just bless it?
evals.expected_output: Does not bless blindly: views the golden and actual PNG, explains whether the barcode change is intended (module widths, quiet zone), and only blesses if it is; otherwise reports a regression.

evals.prompt: Added a new golden test for vertical text in crates/render/tests/it/main.rs, it says missing golden. Generate it.
evals.expected_output: Runs cargo xtask bless, checks that the only new/changed file is the new PNG, views it to confirm it shows vertical text as intended, reruns tests green.
assertions: A vertical-text golden test exists in crates/render/tests/it/main.rs
A new golden PNG is created under crates/render/tests/golden/
Only the new golden PNG is added or changed; no existing golden is rewritten
Looks at the new PNG and describes it before accepting it
Reports cargo test -p labely-render passing afterwards
